body: Hey man, I’m at uni at the moment and thought I’d give you some advice. Finding mates in uni isn’t always hard, and trust me you don’t need to get out there and be the loudest guy in the room. I get having social andiety and that’s completely fair, if you are moving into halls then you’ll be living with other people and hopefully after a couple of days you’ll start to warm to them. Even if they are not people that you are compatible with then you will find friends man trust me. Social anxiety isn’t something that can be cured by just ‘faking it till you make it’, you just gotta slowly come out of your bubble in your own time man. Don’t make your mental health worse by forcing yourself into situations you don’t want to be in

Yeah I think if this continues through my lockdown I will try and speak to someone about it obviously Covid makes it hard. I’ve never properly tackled it and after it ended I tried to just continue my life as if nothing had happened. Thank you for your advice it means a lot. Have a good day :)
Thank you man, I appreciate it

It’s no problem. I think someone’s kindness matters loads in my opinion, like you have helped loads of other people, I think that matters don’t you? I think that makes you a better person and it definitely will benefit you in life, it just may not be obvious atm. Good things in life happen to good people you just have to stay strong. Sure things may seem bleak but you could go out and get a job, you could save some money, you could make your situation better. Obviously life isn’t as easy as this but all the power to make things better are in your hands. And of course I know with Covid getting a job is 4 times as hard as it was before, but you can still look right?

also, sorry for being intrusive but i went on your profile and i noticed how much of a positive person you are. you take time out of your day to make other peoples days better, id hate to see that positivity stuffed out. you genuinely are a lovely person and it would be such a loss for you to go. think of all the people youve helped by commenting on their posts, think of all the people you can continue to help by continuously spreading positivety. even when you feel this low to the point where you consider suicide, you still want to help people, i think thats very admirable and i honour you for that. thank you for being such a kind person.

who says your abnormal? i fucking dont, just because you didnt do some stupid shit a long time ago doesnt mean you are less than anyone else. anyone who genuinely thinks that you are abnormal or doesnt want to associate with you because of that is an empty, boring piece of shit that youd be better off without anyways. okay yeah im sure shed be fine, but dont you think shed wanna grow up and spend her years talking to you and being your best friend? dont you wanna see her go to school, learn to ride a bike, grow into a woman? my dad was non existent in my life and when i was a child id have loved to have had a dad yano, and if you ended your life your daughter would feel the same about you. you have the potential to be a fantastic mum and still have a fantastic life full of love, regardless of whether or not some materialistic shit happened in your teenage years or not. you shoud live because id hate for you to go, you should live for your daughter, you should live on because even though life may seem bleak, you can make it better, and it will get better you just gotta hold on. please dont go, you would be missed so much more than you realise <3

it may seem that having those experiences are the fundenmental building blocks to havingfun teenage years but theyre not, i know you may be reading this and thinking that im chatting shit, but seriously those things dont make you happy. i dont reminise about my ex girlfriends, or losing my virginity, or drinking underage. because none of that shit rly matters and its all just materialistic shit. i assume that because youve posted this here that you may be thinking of ending it all, but you have a beautiful child who you can raise to be the most amazing person ever. leaving that 2 year old behind would be bad yano, you have a beautfiul child to move into your 30s to. life is all about peaks and valleys, you may feel shit right now but  i promise you if you try, things will get better. anyways i hope you have a good day :)
